item.title: ‘Rosebush Pruning’ Review: Karim Aïnouz Meets Greek Weird Wave in Uneven But Fun Eat-The-Rich Satire [Berlin]
item.description: The very first glimpse of Karim Aïnouz’s long-gestating “Rosebush Pruning” is a bold title card in bright red and yellow. The two colors guide the story’s visual language, quietly and consistently evoking the old Karl Marx quote: “Capital comes dripping from head to foot, from every pore, with blood and dirt.” Surrounded by years of speculation and following a series of recasts and delays, “Rosebush Pruning” arrived at the prestigious Berlin Film Festival under a fair shroud of secrecy.
